text:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — I'm prototyping a per-route KPI dashboard in Console to surface token-level latency breakdowns (decode / kv_lookup / kernel_exec / enqueue_wait), per-route throughput and error_rate. Need input on instrumentation and UI.

Elliot Park: Nice. Today we only ship end-to-end request latency + tokens/sec. This will help root-cause for the recent p95 spikes.

Priya Nair: Exactly. Proposal for runtime metrics (names + labels):
- token_decode_ms_bucket / _sum / _count (labels: route, model_variant, seq_len_bucket)
- kv_lookup_ms_bucket / _sum / _count (labels: route, kv_hit)
- kernel_exec_ms_bucket / _sum / _count (labels: route, kernel_path, cu_affinity)
- enqueue_wait_ms_bucket (labels: route, batch_size)
- batch_size_histogram (labels: route, model_variant)
- route_request_total (labels: route, status_code)

Samir Gupta: +1 on histograms. Also export a derived gauge token_latency_p50/p95/p99 per route for Console panels to avoid heavy client-side aggregations. For kernel path label, include values like `int8`, `f16`, `f32`, `fallback`.

Jules Tran: UX ask: Console should show a waterfall stacked view for a given route (p50/p95 bars broken into stages) and a small sparkline for throughput. Can we emit percentiles at multiple quantiles to power that?

Taylor Morgan: Quick background — after the kernel-selector change in commit `abc1234` we saw p95 regressions on short sequences (<32). Profiling shows kernel_exec_ms median +12% for the new path due to suboptimal thread/block config on Ampere. We need per-kernel metrics to correlate with route and seq_len.

Priya Nair: I captured a distributed trace example for a single token path (kv warm vs cold). Sample numbers from trace:
- kv_hit=true: kv_lookup_ms=0.42ms, token_decode_ms=0.88ms, kernel_exec_ms=1.6ms, enqueue_wait_ms=0.3ms
- kv_hit=false: kv_lookup_ms=6.12ms, token_decode_ms=0.92ms, kernel_exec_ms=1.9ms, enqueue_wait_ms=0.35ms

Priya Nair: Example PromQL snippets we can use in Console panels:```
# p95 token latency by route (histogram_quantile)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))

# kernel exec p95 split by kernel_path
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kernel_exec_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, kernel_path))

# throughput (tokens/sec) per route
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (route)
```

Elliot Park: That PromQL looks good. Two operational asks: 1) label cardinality — route + model_variant + seq_len_bucket can blow up. Limit seq_len_bucket to coarse bins (0-16,17-64,65-256,256+). 2) batch_size should be bucketed not free-form.

Samir Gupta: Agreed on buckets. Also propose emitting a light-weight `route_profile` metric once per minute with summarized fields so Console can compute delta-based p95 without re-querying the whole histogram.

Taylor Morgan: On the kernel selector side I'll add telemetry: emit `kernel_selector_decision_total{route,seq_len_bucket,kernel_path,reason}` on every allocation so we can see how often the new path fires and correlate to latency. I'll also attach a perf flag to rollback if regression > 5% at p95.

Jules Tran: For UI: I'll prototype a per-route panel with: top row p50/p95/p99 (numbers), middle waterfall stacked bar (stage percentages), bottom mini-heatmap for batch_size distribution and error_rate. If you can provide sample queries and a small CSV of traces I can mock data.

Priya Nair: Pasting a 3-line CSV example (route,kv_hit,seq_len,kernel_path,token_latency_ms) to seed the prototype:```
checkout-v1,true,12,int8,3.2
checkout-v1,false,48,f16,8.7
chat-stream,true,8,int8,2.6
```

deploy-bot: deploy `perf-metrics/proto` @ priya -> production succeeded (rollout 1/3). :rocket:

Samir Gupta: Quick flag for perf regressions — include a synthetic workload route that emits controlled seq_len distributions so we can compare kernel paths deterministically. Otherwise noisy production traffic will mask regressions.

Priya Nair: Good call. I'll add a synthetic `perf-check` route in the harness and wire it to the new histograms. Plan:
- Priya: instrument token-level histograms + sample traces (PR today)
- Taylor: kernel selector decision metric + perf flag (PR by EOD)
- Samir: synthetic perf-check workload + derived gauges (this week)
- Jules: dashboard mockups + Console panel config (ETA next Wed)

Elliot Park: +1. Please add small docs in eng-runtime/README with metric names and label conventions.

Samir Gupta: ack

Taylor Morgan: ack

Jules Tran: will post mock screenshots in the thread when ready

Priya Nair: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the PR links and sample queries. If anyone wants early access to the test route ping me. :thumbsup:
